subject.title: perf(sessions): watermark-cache derived titles and single-pass list filtering

question: Should maintainers require a redacted real-runtime benchmark or trace showing an unchanged `sessions.list` response and warm-cache improvement before merging this gateway performance change?
rationale: The PR has meaningful focused tests and many completed checks, but the external-PR proof gate requires observable after-fix behavior rather than test and CI claims alone; the protected maintainer label also requires human handling.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal trace or benchmark from a representative session store that shows response parity and a faster warmed second list call.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the existing parity and invalidation coverage as sufficient for this internal performance optimization.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal trace or benchmark from a representative session store that shows response parity and a faster warmed second list call.

likelyOwner.reason: They have direct continuity with the immediately preceding merged title-probe performance work and can most readily provide the requested runtime evidence.
